Tests for relative pkg path queries with only xtest pkgs.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module mod.test/resolvetarget

go 1.25

-- f/a/sub/sub.go --
package sub

var Sub = "sub" //@target(f_a_sub_Sub, "mod.test/resolvetarget/f/a/sub", "Sub", "Sub")

-- f/a/a_test.go --
// IMPORTANT: The only package in this directory is a test package.
package a_test

var ABC = "a" //@target(f_a_test_ABC, "mod.test/resolvetarget/f/a_test", "ABC", "ABC")

// External test file: relative subpackage lookup should use ForTest (f/a) rather than PkgPath (f/a_test).
//@resolvetarget("sub.Sub", "", f_a_sub_Sub)
//@resolvetarget("Sub", "sub", f_a_sub_Sub)

-- f/a/ --

// Directory with only xtest files: relative subpackage lookup should use ForTest (f/a) rather than PkgPath (f/a_test).
//@resolvetarget("sub.Sub", "", f_a_sub_Sub)
//@resolvetarget("Sub", "sub", f_a_sub_Sub)

-- f/ --

//@resolvetarget("a_test.ABC", "", f_a_test_ABC)
